threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think getting a coffee means waiting in a queue at the barista instead of knowing the right spot for a takeaway flat white.
Last night on the 36, a guy insisted the driver was a secret agent. He showed everyone his 'evidence'—a half-eaten sausage roll. Classic Peckham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw someone setting up a barbershop in a bus stop shelter; only in Neukölln do you find creativity in the mundane.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you can find spontaneous techno parties in abandoned buildings—nothing like dancing in a former factory at 3 AM.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they navigate a BART delay—no whining, just immediately checking the bus schedule and heading for tacos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 at Civic Center today, and a guy started reciting poetry to the passengers. Muni's theater in transit never fails.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just all about the gaudí, but they miss out on the hidden plazas where locals sip vermut and share stories.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still taking photos of every little detail in Plaça del Sol, oblivious to the usual sunbathers giving them sideways glances.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when a bus driver grumbles at you for not having the right change. Everyone else knows to keep 50p handy.
Heard a couple arguing about whether KFC or McDonald's is better. By the time we hit Clapham, they'd switched to singing old Spice Girls songs. Quite the ride!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Watching a guy fix his bicycle by the corner store while a stray cat sunbathes on the pavement. That's Neukölln magic right there.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you catch a party in a former power plant while hearing the U-Bahn rumble underground. It's a vibe all its own.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their ability to navigate BART delays with a coffee in hand, while the newcomers go into full meltdown mode.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 at Civic Center today, a dog decided to take a nap on the tracks. Only in SF do we stop for a snoozing pup.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about the parks and squares, but miss the hidden art galleries tucked in old shops along Carrer de Verdi.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their confused looks at the TMB maps; locals know the shortcuts and which stops to skip.
